rubric.role_summary: Senior mechanical engineering role focused on thermal design and performance of consumer sleep products, from concept through production, including analysis, testing, and manufacturing support.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior mechanical engineering role focused on thermal design and performance of consumer sleep products, from concept through production, including analysis, testing, and manufacturing support.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in thermal system engineering.
- Experience in thermal and fluid analysis and heat transfer.
- Experience with simulation and data analysis tools.
- Experience shipping high-volume consumer products.
- Proficiency in CAD.
- BSME or equivalent.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- MS or PhD.
- Expertise in thermal and fluid analysis, heat transfer fundamentals, thermal instrumentation, DOEs, and root cause analysis techniques.
- High proficiency with simulation and data analysis tools; the named tools are examples, not required individually.
- Experience shipping high-volume consumer products, including manufacturing support in Asia.
- Proficiency in CAD and DFM/DFA; the named CAD packages are examples.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
